verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail is a SaaS virtual-mailbox service that advertises APIs, so publishing llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair axis for it. The evidence pack never mentions llms.txt, machine-readable docs, or any documentation written for agents. Generic API-integration claims and AI mail summaries are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
